name: Anal * Teacher ~Kando Ryoukou!? Gyaku Lesson~
original_name: アナル＊ティーチャー ～感度良肛!? 逆レッスン～
source:
Hanai Mifuyu, who is a teacher at this school, is worried about one student. Koda Shinji, is a male student who is extremely quiet and unobtrusive.

It seems that he has been bullied since he entered this class. She decided to invite Koda-kun to the Lifestyle Guidance Room to talk about the current situation and future. I whisper gently, caring for Koda-kun, who looks down silently.

Perhaps it was when I exhaled a little while looking into his face, which still didn’t say anything.
“Kuku … Don’t worry, sir. I’ve been trying to get you bullied.”

Koda-kun laughed back mysteriously, and I didn’t understand what he said for a moment.

If you don’t follow your own obedience, you will commit suicide, leaving behind a suicide note that has plagued bullying.

That said, he says he was being bullied to threaten me.
A person who wants to manipulate people and do what he wants.

For that purpose, it’s okay to lie or hurt people. That was Koda-kun’s true nature.
“I’ve always been curious … What kind of voice does the teacher scream?”

I noticed that my wrist was being grabbed.

The thing that Koda-kun is clenching … it was a big syringe … no, it looked like a huge enema.
“Hey, let me know, teacher …?”
translation:
这所学校的老师花井美冬很担心一名学生。幸田慎司，是一名极其安静、不引人注目的男学生。

看来自从进入这个班级以来，他就一直被欺负。她决定邀请幸田君到生活指导室谈谈现在的状况和未来。我温柔地低声说道，关心着默默低头的幸田君。

也许是当我看着他的脸时轻轻呼了一口气，他的脸仍然没有说什么。
“库库……别担心，先生。我一直在想办法让你被欺负。”

幸田君神秘地笑了笑，我一时没明白他在说什么。

如果你不服从自己的命令，你就会自杀，留下一封困扰欺凌的遗书。

也就是说，他说他被欺负来威胁我。
一个想要操纵别人并做他想做的事的人。

为了这个目的，撒谎或伤害别人是可以的。这就是幸田君的本性。
“我一直很好奇……老师尖叫的声音是什么样的？”

我注意到我的手腕被抓住了。

幸田君握着的东西……那是一个大注射器……不，它看起来像是一个巨大的灌肠剂。
“嘿，请告诉我，老师……？”
